info.long_name: Percent of students complete for all required vaccines
info.short_description: Percent of students up to date for every vaccine the state requires at that grade.
info.long_description: Percent of assessed students in the grade who were up to date for every vaccine the state requires at that grade. The required vaccines differ by state. Reported by AK, CT, LA, and WA.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of students had all required vaccines

info.long_name: Percent of students with any exemption
info.short_description: Percent of students with any exemption.
info.long_description: Percent of students in the grade with any exemption from one or more required vaccines. Reported by LA, MA, and WA.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of students had an exemption

info.long_name: Percent of adolescents up to date for HPV vaccine
info.short_description: Percent of adolescents up to date for HPV vaccine.
info.long_description: Percent of adolescents ages 13-17 up to date for human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine. Reported by Alaska only.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of adolescents were up to date for HPV vaccine

info.long_name: Percent of students with a medical exemption
info.short_description: Percent of students with a medical exemption.
info.long_description: Percent of students in the grade with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines. Reported by CT, MA, ND, and WA.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of students had a medical exemption

info.long_name: Percent of students up to date for meningococcal conjugate (MenACWY) vaccine
info.short_description: Percent of students up to date for meningococcal conjugate (MenACWY) vaccine.
info.long_description: Percent of assessed students in the grade who were up to date for meningococcal conjugate (MenACWY) vaccine. Definitions vary by state. Reported by AK, CT, IN, LA, MA, ND, and TX.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of students were up to date for MenACWY

info.long_name: Percent of students with a personal or philosophical exemption
info.short_description: Percent of students with a personal belief exemption.
info.long_description: Percent of students in the grade with a personal belief exemption from one or more required vaccines. Texas calls these conscientious exemptions. Reported by ND, TX, and WA.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of students had a personal belief exemption

info.long_name: Percent of students with a religious exemption
info.short_description: Percent of students with a religious exemption.
info.long_description: Percent of students in the grade with a religious exemption from one or more required vaccines. Reported by CT, MA, ND, and WA. Connecticut ended new religious exemptions in 2021 but existing ones carry forward.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of students had a religious exemption

info.long_name: Percent of students up to date for Tdap
info.short_description: Percent of students up to date for the Tdap booster.
info.long_description: Percent of assessed students in the grade who were up to date for the tetanus, diphtheria, and pertussis (Tdap) booster. Definitions vary by state. Reported by AK, CT, IN, LA, MA, ND, and TX.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of students were up to date for Tdap
